learning_outcomes.text: Understand the physical principles of semiconductors.
Know the operation and applications of basic semiconductor-based electronic devices.
Analyze and design basic analog electronic circuits.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of electronics.

assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained from two parts: 80% theory and problems, and 20% laboratory practices. To pass the course, a final grade of 5 out of 10 is required as a result of the weighting of both parts. Additionally, a minimum of 4 out of 10 must be obtained separately in each of the two parts. Grades equal to or higher than 4 in each part will remain valid until the next extraordinary exam session.
